line.s_store.text: I am collecting pine cones for winter. Look how many I have!

line.s_how_many.text: Lovely! And how many exactly do you have?

line.s_lots.text: Lots! I have lots and lots of them!

line.s_lots_not.text: Lots is not an answer. Tomorrow you will not know if one went missing.

line.s_count.text: By counting! Then you know exactly how many there are.

line.s_show.text: I will show you, it is fun. We point to each cone only once and say the numbers in order.

line.s_start_one.text: Let's start with one cone. Point to it.

line.s_count_again.text: Count from the start. Point to every cone only once.

line.s_two.text: The last number tells how many there are. You have two cones!

line.s_point_2.text: I have two cones. Point to the digit two.

line.s_last.text: The last number tells how many there are. You have three cones!

line.s_digits.text: A number can also be written down. We write it with a digit. Look.

line.s_point_3.text: I have three cones. Point to the digit three.

line.wrong_digit.text: That is another digit. Look again.

line.s_solved.text: I will write a three by my store. Tomorrow I will count and check that they are all there!

line.s_to_brook.text: Let's go to the brook. There is something to count there too.

line.b_pebbles.text: Let's collect pebbles for hopscotch. I have a few.

line.b_count.text: Count them. Point to each pebble only once.

line.b_four.text: Four pebbles! The last number is four.

line.b_pick_4.text: There is a four among the cards. Point to the digit four.

line.good_digit.text: Yes! That is the digit. Great!

line.b_to_home.text: Let's go home. Cookies are waiting for us!

line.c_cookies.text: I baked cookies for the guests. Let's count how many I baked.

line.c_five.text: Five cookies! The last number is five.

line.c_two_plates.text: Now there are two groups of cookies. One of them has five.

line.c_pick_5.text: Point to the group with five cookies. You can count them.

line.c_wrong_5.text: Count again. There are fewer than five here.

line.c_solved.text: Well done! Now you can count to five and you know five digits.

line.p_intro.text: Let's play counting! Count the things and find their digit.

line.p_how_many.text: How many are there? Point to the right digit.

line.p_group_1.text: Point to the group with only one thing.

line.p_group_4.text: Point to the group with four things.

line.p_wrong_group.text: Count again, each thing only once.

line.a_game.text: Let's play counting toys, just like at home.

line.a_ok.text: All right! I show the toys and you count.

line.a_count_klocek.text: Count the blocks. Point to each one in turn.

line.a_count_misiu.text: Now the teddy bears. How many are there?

line.a_count_pilka.text: And now the balls. Count them all.

line.a_which_digit.text: Point to the digit that tells how many there are.

line.a_ask_parents.text: Ask your parents to count toys or the plates on the table with you.

line.d1.text: This is a one. It looks like a stick with a little nose.

line.d2.text: This is a two. It looks like a swan swimming on the water.

line.d3.text: This is a three. It has two tummies, one on top of the other.

line.d4.text: This is a four. It looks like a little chair turned upside down.

line.d5.text: This is a five. It has a straight hat and a round tummy.

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for our adventure together! Here's a sticker for your album, to remember it by. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is the pine cone from Squirrel. We got it when we learned to count to five.
